supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Significant lateral extension beyond the ocular orbits

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Low contrast; uniform dark dermal pigmentation with increased pixel intensity (lighter) in the mandibular region due to grey follicular growth

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thin vertical profile with a neutral, non-drooping structural posture

pinna_silhouette.outer_helix_geometry: Asymmetrical; rounded silhouette on the right ear and an angular/pointed apex on the left ear

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe structural trauma and scarring centered on the right periocular region, resulting in an apparently closed or non-functional eye and irregular dermal surface
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white/grey hair distribution across the mental and mandibular zones
